title.vi: Vụ đặt phòng khách sạn bí ẩn

summary.en: A student group's hotel booking for a conference shows the wrong dates, the wrong room and a higher price. Is the hotel cheating them?
summary.vi: Đơn đặt phòng khách sạn của một nhóm sinh viên đi dự hội nghị bị sai ngày, sai loại phòng và giá cao hơn dự kiến. Có phải khách sạn đang lừa họ?

setting: Lakeside University and a hotel in Da Nang

briefing.en: It is Monday 15 February 2027. Thao Le, a student at Lakeside University, has booked a hotel in Da Nang for four students who will attend the Young Researchers Conference in March. The booking confirmation shows different dates, a different room type and a much higher price. Some people online say the hotel cheats students. Thao's supervisor, Ms. Rachel Vo, has asked the English Detective Agency to find out what went wrong. Read the booking documents carefully, find the information that does not match, interview the people involved and write a report with your conclusion and recommendations.
briefing.vi: Hôm nay là thứ Hai, ngày 15 tháng 2 năm 2027. Thao Le, sinh viên Trường Đại học Lakeside, đã đặt khách sạn ở Đà Nẵng cho bốn sinh viên sẽ tham dự Hội nghị Nhà nghiên cứu trẻ vào tháng 3. Tuy nhiên, xác nhận đặt phòng lại ghi ngày khác, loại phòng khác và giá cao hơn nhiều. Một số người trên mạng nói khách sạn này lừa sinh viên. Cô Rachel Vo, giảng viên hướng dẫn của Thao, đã nhờ English Detective Agency tìm ra nguyên nhân. Hãy đọc kỹ các tài liệu đặt phòng, tìm những thông tin không khớp, phỏng vấn những người liên quan và viết báo cáo nêu kết luận cùng khuyến nghị.

objectives.en: Compare Thao's request with the booking confirmation and the receipt.
objectives.vi: Đối chiếu yêu cầu của Thao với xác nhận đặt phòng và biên lai thanh toán.

objectives.en: Find the information that is wrong or does not match.
objectives.vi: Tìm những thông tin bị sai hoặc không khớp nhau.

objectives.en: Interview Thao, the hotel receptionist and the booking platform agent.
objectives.vi: Phỏng vấn Thao, nhân viên lễ tân khách sạn và nhân viên nền tảng đặt phòng.

objectives.en: Write a report that explains the cause and gives recommendations.
objectives.vi: Viết báo cáo giải thích nguyên nhân và đưa ra khuyến nghị.

meta.Subject: Hotel plan for the Young Researchers Conference

documents.body:
Dear Ms. Vo,

Here is my plan for our hotel in Da Nang. The Young Researchers Conference takes place from Thursday 4 March to Saturday 6 March 2027 at the Da Nang Convention Centre.

There are four of us: Minh, Lan, Quoc and me. I would like to book two twin rooms at the Seabreeze Hotel for three nights. We will check in on Thursday 4 March and check out on Sunday 7 March.

The hotel website says a twin room costs 800,000 VND per night, so the total price should be 4,800,000 VND. This is within our faculty budget of 5,000,000 VND.

I will book tonight on TripNest, because the faculty always uses TripNest and pays with the university travel card.

Best wishes,
Thao Le
Media Club, Faculty of Communication

★★★★★ "Lovely breakfast" – Mai, Hanoi (January 2027)
The breakfast buffet was excellent and the Vietnamese coffee was amazing. Friendly staff.

★☆☆☆☆ "Dishonest hotel!" – Kevin (February 2027)
This hotel cheats students! They changed my room and took extra money. Never trust them.

I typed 05/06 for 5 June, but TripNest booked my room for 6 May. It was not the hotel's mistake. The receptionist helped me to contact TripNest and fix it.

documents.title: TripNest Booking Record – TN-58217 (customer input)
documents.body:
BOOKING RECORD TN-58217

Created: 12 February 2027, 21:45 (TripNest website, Vietnam)
Customer: Thao Le

Customer input:
- Check-in date (format MM/DD/YYYY): 04/03/2027
- Number of nights: 3
- Rooms: 2 x Twin Room
- Guests: 4 adults

System result:
- Check-in date read as: 3 April 2027
- Twin Room availability (3–6 April): not available
- Automatic change: 1 x Family Room (4 guests), 3 nights x 2,100,000 VND = 6,300,000 VND

Account security: no changes to the booking after 21:48 on 12 February. No new device or login from another country.

Support note (15 February): The date box on our booking form shows the format MM/DD/YYYY only in small grey letters. We have received 14 similar complaints this month.

questions.prompt: Why is the total price in the confirmation (6,300,000 VND) higher than the price Thao expected? Answer in 1–3 sentences.
keyPoints: The booking is for April, when the hotel uses higher prices (1 April – 31 August).
The room is one Family Room, not two twin rooms.
3 nights x 2,100,000 VND (Family Room in April) = 6,300,000 VND.
questions.sampleAnswer: The booking is for 3–6 April, and from 1 April the hotel prices are higher. Also, the room is a Family Room at 2,100,000 VND per night, so three nights cost 6,300,000 VND instead of 4,800,000 VND for two twin rooms in March.

questions.prompt: Which details in the booking confirmation do not match Thao's plan? Give two examples in 1–3 sentences.
keyPoints: The dates: Thao wanted 4–7 March, but the confirmation says 3–6 April.
The room type: Thao wanted two twin rooms, but the confirmation shows one Family Room.
The price: Thao expected 4,800,000 VND, but she paid 6,300,000 VND.
questions.sampleAnswer: Thao wanted to stay from 4 to 7 March, but the confirmation says 3 to 6 April. She also wanted two twin rooms, but the confirmation shows one Family Room for 6,300,000 VND.

facts.text: Thao typed the check-in date as 04/03/2027, because in Vietnam this means 4 March.
On the TripNest form, Thao selected two twin rooms for four guests. She did not choose a family room.
Thao paid at 21:47 on 12 February, but she read the confirmation email carefully only on 14 February.
Thao did not see any date format on the form; she only remembers an empty date box with some small grey text.

facts.text: The hotel received booking TN-58217 from TripNest for one Family Room from 3 to 6 April 2027, and the hotel did not change it.
The hotel has not received any money for booking TN-58217; TripNest pays the hotel after the guests check out.
The hotel still has two twin rooms free from 4 to 7 March 2027, at 800,000 VND per room per night.
The hotel cannot change a TripNest booking itself; TripNest must cancel or change it.

characters.personality: Polite, efficient and a little formal; follows company rules and checks the system before he answers.

facts.text: Leo checked booking TN-58217 in the TripNest system and can share the booking record that shows what the customer typed.
The TripNest booking form uses the month-first date format MM/DD/YYYY for customers in every country.
When the chosen room type is not available, the TripNest system can automatically choose a similar room at the same or a higher price.
Booking TN-58217 can be cancelled for free until 27 March 2027, which is 7 days before check-in.

conclusion.question: What is the most likely cause of the wrong hotel booking?

options.text: The booking platform read 04/03/2027 month-first as 3 April, so it booked the wrong dates and then automatically changed the room and the price. The hotel did not cheat.
The hotel changed the booking on purpose to get more money from the students.
Thao chose a Family Room in April by herself, and there was no problem with the booking system.
Someone hacked Thao's TripNest account and changed the booking.

unsupportedClaims: The hotel cheats students (only angry reviews say this; the hotel has not received any money).
The hotel raises prices for students (the website shows normal seasonal prices for everyone).
Thao chose the Family Room (the booking record shows she selected two twin rooms).
Thao's account was hacked (there was no new device or login from another country).

writingTask.prompt: Write an incident report to Ms. Rachel Vo about the hotel booking for the conference trip. Include: a short summary, the information that is wrong in the booking, the evidence you found, the cause of the problem and your recommendations.
writingTask.audience: Ms. Rachel Vo, Faculty of Communication, Lakeside University
keyPoints: Identifies the wrong information: dates (3–6 April instead of 4–7 March), room type (one Family Room instead of two twin rooms) and price (6,300,000 instead of 4,800,000 VND).
Explains the cause: TripNest's form uses MM/DD/YYYY, so 04/03/2027 was read as 3 April.
Explains that twin rooms were full in April, so the system automatically chose a Family Room at the high-season price.
States that there is no evidence of fraud by the hotel (the money went to TripNest; the hotel only received what TripNest sent).
Recommends cancelling for free before 27 March, rebooking twin rooms for 4–7 March and checking date formats in future.

documents: Start with Thao's email and the booking confirmation. Put them side by side.
Compare the dates, the room type and the price in each document.
Look at the numbers in the dates: what happens if you swap the day and the month?
evidence: Highlight dates, room types and prices that do not match.
Reviews are opinions from other guests; some are not about the booking at all.
Find out who received the money and who made the changes.
interviews: Ask the TripNest agent to check the booking record in the system.
Ask Thao how she typed the dates on the website.
Ask the hotel receptionist whether the hotel has received any payment.
analysis: Official records, receipts and the hotel website are verified; angry reviews are unverified.
Link the date Thao typed with the date the system read.
Ask yourself: is there any real evidence that the hotel wanted to cheat?
report: Use the five sections: summary, problems found, evidence, cause, recommendations.
Use comparing language such as 'instead of', 'however' and 'but'.
Give practical recommendations for Thao, the faculty and TripNest.

conclusion.justification: Thao planned 4–7 March, but she typed 04/03/2027 into a month-first date box, so TripNest read it as 3 April. Twin rooms were full in April, so the system chose a Family Room. The money went to TripNest, not to the hotel.

sampleSolution.report:
Summary: On 12 February 2027, Thao Le booked a hotel on TripNest for our trip to the Young Researchers Conference in Da Nang. The confirmation shows the wrong dates, the wrong room type and a higher price.

Problems found: Thao planned to stay in two twin rooms from 4 to 7 March. However, the confirmation shows one Family Room from 3 to 6 April, and the total price is 6,300,000 VND instead of 4,800,000 VND.

Evidence: The TripNest booking record shows that the date box uses the format MM/DD/YYYY. Thao entered 04/03/2027, which means 4 March in Vietnam, but the system read it as 3 April. Twin rooms are fully booked in early April, so the system automatically chose a Family Room at the higher April price.

Cause: This was a date format problem on the booking platform, not fraud by the hotel. The money was paid to TripNest, and the hotel only received the booking that TripNest sent.

Recommendations: Thao should cancel the booking for free before 27 March and book two twin rooms for 4–7 March. TripNest should show the date format clearly.
